display_name: spring-boot + nginx (8 replicas, no CPU limits)
description: Experimental, not for merge. spring-boot-gateway-8 without CPU limits: 8 Spring Boot replicas behind one nginx edge share 24 logical CPUs with no CFS quota, like pods with requests but no limits. Each runs with -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=3, 6g of memory and a 24-connection Hikari pool; compare with spring-boot-gateway-8 (limited) and spring-boot-gateway-3-unlimited.
